scene: The open workbench drawer reveals strange tools and a glowing keycard.
picture: Close view looking directly down into the cluttered wooden workbench drawer. The player's hands reach in. On the left lies a faintly glowing purple electronic keycard. In the centre rests a pocket-sized brass meter with a vibrating needle. On the far right sits an iron lockbox with a heavy key in its keyhole.
shown: A pulsing violet plastic keycard resting inside the drawer on the left
A tiny brass handheld frequency meter sitting in the drawer centre
A heavy rusted skeleton key stuck in a lockbox far right

variants.scene: You slide out the wooden drawer and find three curious gizmos inside.
The timber drawer smells like motor oil, holding gadgets and loose screws.
